description.value: SookePoint Ocean Cottage Resort is a cliffside luxury vacation-rental resort perched above the Pacific Ocean on the western edge of Vancouver Island, roughly 60 minutes from Victoria. It offers cottage suites ranging from intimate studios to 3-bedroom units, all featuring ocean views over Emerald Bay, kitchenettes or full kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, and balconies in most suites. The resort is pet-friendly and is managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, with active development underway to expand its oceanfront cottage and yacht-suite inventory.

No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content; the amenities nav link was not fetched in detail, so all cycling amenities remain null.
